_comment: Screen positions of the War Thunder menu elements the automation clicks,
taken from 1920x1080 screenshots. Coordinates are stored as fractions of
the screen so they survive a different resolution, but the layout itself
is not guaranteed to scale, so check with --dry-run --shot after any
Positions were read off the Russian client; the automation never reads
text, so the interface language does not matter.

community_replays.note: Повторы, third item in the dropdown

list.note: Replay list, newest first. Rows beyond visible_rows need scrolling.

scoreboard.note: Players sorted by score. Read offline with wtresults instead.

player_list.note: Order is live and reorders during the battle, so a row index cannot reliably pick a named player. The replay opens on its author, which is who we follow.
